notes.title: Update 06_24_2025
notes.notes: Added tutorial videos and voiceovers for game introduction. Managed a few minor bugs and tweaks that were identified during a few playtests. Boss no longer resides in the first level.

notes.title: Vertical Slice Update: Blight Upgrades & UI Overhaul
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve pushed a major update to the [i]Blightened[/i] playtest build. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]💀 Blight Economy Unlocked[/b]
Collect blight to [b]upgrade health[/b] and [b]carry capacity[/b]. Choose how you grow — more survivability or resource control.[/p][/*][*][p][b]⚔️ Combat Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Timing-based light attacks refined for a more responsive feel[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hit windows and minor ability sync issues[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller navigation and feedback[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]🧊 Front-End UI Rebuild[/b]
All new UI with new [b]Settings[/b], [b]Resolution[/b], and [b]Controls[/b] interfaces[/p][list][*][p]Controller support is much better [/p][/*][*][p]Dropdown resolution selector[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust Audio[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle Fullscreen or Window[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]🔧 Additional Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Audio mix now respects player settings[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution now defaults properly across multi-monitor setups[/p][/*][*][p]General polish across all menus and HUD transitions

Thanks to everyone playtesting and providing feedback — it’s making [i]Blightened[/i] sharper each day.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Play now and let us know if you can break it.[/b] 🐛🔥Getting closer to an official demo here in a few weeks. Hoping its only 2 but the we want to add more polish to the visuals.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🔥 Playtest Update: A Volcanic Trial Awaits
notes.notes:
[p]The Blightened playtest just got hotter.[/p][p]Explore the newly unlocked [b]Volcanic Rupture[/b] — a hellish biome pulsing with molten platforms, burning traps, and corrupted architecture. This level introduces:[/p][list][*][p][b]Lava geysers[/b] and [b]timed flame bursts[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Spiked crushers and chained scythe traps[/p][/*][*][p]Prison chambers buried in magma[/p][/*][*][p]Unforgiving platforming over lakes of fire[/p][/*][*][p]A haunting new aesthetic that cranks up the visual intensity[/p][/*][/list][p]Welcome to [b]Rupture Cycle: 32019 FA — 02:15:36:15[/b]
This timeline burns hotter than anything that came before.[/p][p]Jump in, test your skills, and tell us what scorched you the most.[/p]

notes.title: Added controller and keyboard instructions
notes.notes: Bats move faster now but have less health. For quality of life, the keyboard instructions are available at the start screen.
